NewsArticle.Title: Class Dedication Over 33% Faster
NewsArticle.Content:
Thank you for your feedback. Dedication to a new class is now over 33% faster.
- 40% faster health, mana, and experience requirements.
- Mundanes provided some new information on what class re-dedication entails, answering questions such as: Should I carry items to the initiation? (no, you will become too weak) What items may I use in the new class? (the items that the new class can use). And more.
See previous [Class Dedication news](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/001004.html) and the mundanes in Temuair for details.
